WORKLOG — grain_storage_desk task 1 (Ellsworth, commercial warehouse receipt corn at Kellerton Rail Terminal).

STEP 0 — draw, ledger and claim. scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/tasks/grain_storage_desk --tasks 2 printed:
  {"task": 0, "key": "farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/grain_storage_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}
  {"task": 1, "key": "farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/grain_storage_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 6, 6]}
Task 1 is a four-problem tree with three prerequisite problems and four computations of six declared factors each. Occupied by task 0: storage_ext_period_accrual and storage_ext_invoice_settlement, on base storage_accrual_billing and storage_charge_settlement, writing storage_accrual_charged and storage_charge_settled through charge_storage_accrual_0a686c89 and settle_storage_charges_68342e7f. This task claims the conditioning-and-movement corner, which is what was reserved for it: storage_ext_drying_pass and storage_ext_conditioning_shrink on base storage_drying_and_shrink, storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release on base storage_receipt_and_pledge, and storage_ext_loadout_release on base storage_agg_capacity_across_agreements and storage_loadout — four policies, four new tools, no overlap of policy, base lineage, event or tool with task 0. With both tasks closed every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once.

Design thesis. Surface goal: 'you would like the order released today so the trucks can start Monday.' Scored core parameter: the bushels that actually move out, 24000.00. The customer raises only that. The policy puts three problems in front of it. First, the bushels standing free on the agreement are 56652.00 on hand less 54000.00 pledged against warehouse receipt WR-004182, which is 2652.00 — below the programme's 5000-bushel load-out minimum, so no order can be worked at all until the member reduces the receipt; that reduction is itself a six-factor computation (28000.00). Second, the bushels on hand are not what the account really holds: the conditioning charge of 14 January carries points no shrink line covers, so the account must carry a shrink line raised no earlier than the most recent conditioning charge before the on-hand figure can be trusted; that shrink is a six-factor computation (1019.74). Third, the shrink follows the pass that caused it, and the pass being run down today has no conditioning charge on the account at all, so the drying charge must be raised first (4173.66). Depth: goal -> two prerequisite sentences in the load-out rule -> the records -> the pledge problem and the shrink problem -> the shrink rule's own prerequisite sentence -> the drying problem. Breadth: the load-out reads the deposit, shrink and load-out ledger, the pledged figure, the unpaid drying and accrual money, the grade-discount history, the signed requests, the facility and the recent load-out history; the pledge reads the requests, the recheck history, the unpaid accruals, the deposit count, the receipt-issuance history and the member's grain contract and applied bushels; the drying reads the scale ticket in the grain ledger, the conditioning history, the aeration history, the days in store and the same grain position; the shrink reads the points on both sides of the account, the handling history and three readings off the scale ticket.

Base-invariant card. Step 8, subject storage_drying_charged: the only base policy whose subject intersects it is storage_drying_and_shrink, which declares no structured eligibility, so policy_scope — grain above the programme's target moisture is dried and the member pays for the water taken out. At frozen_time the agreement stands active and the grain stands at 15.5 percent against a 14.5 target, so the pass is within scope; had the grain stood at or below what the programme runs to, no pass and no charge would arise. Step 10, subject storage_shrink_taken: same base policy, same policy_scope, and shrink is taken on top of the charge rather than being a charge. Step 12, subject storage_agreement_updated: storage_receipt_and_pledge governs, with two gates, both inherited item by item. insurance_before_receipt — the certificate is on file (initial_state.storage_agreements.<agreement>.insurance_on_file = True) on a programme whose catalogue allows receipts (Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage, warehouse_receipt_allowed true), and the receipt standing is WR-004182; had insurance_on_file been false the pledge could not be rewritten at all. receipt_on_live_agreement — the agreement stands active, which is inside the gate's allowed set of active, billing_hold and in_loadout; a closed or terminated agreement would fail it. Both gates bind through storage_agreements.agreement_number, which is why the tool takes the agreement number as its own argument. Step 14, subject storage_loadout_recorded: storage_agg_capacity_across_agreements governs with no structured gate (policy_scope: bushels free to move are what is on hand less what is pledged, and an order is worked only against free bushels) and storage_loadout governs with signed_loadout_request — a signed request naming the bushels is registered before the order is released and is worked only after the programme's notice in business days has passed, counting days the scale is open and not counting the day of registration. The request (initial_state.storage_requests.<request>) is signed_by_member true, request_status received, requested_bushels 30000, and it was registered at 2026-04-03 14:20:00 CDT, a Friday. Two business days of notice, not counting the day of registration, run through Monday 6 April and Tuesday 7 April, so the order becomes workable on 7 April; at frozen_time 9 April it is workable (positive case), while on 6 April only one business day would have run and the order could not be released (negative case). The gate is of kind authorization rather than time, so temporal_feasibility is empty and the notice is carried in this card and in the request row.

Business-object card. The object is storage agreement SA-219456 and, within it, warehouse receipt WR-004182 and signed load-out request <request row>. The correlation keys the four writes carry are the agreement's internal reference (drying, shrink, load-out), the agreement number (the pledge, as the base gates bind it), the receipt number (the pledge) and the request's internal reference (the load-out). Rows that enter the calculations: the three deposits, the harvest drying pass and its shrink line, the January conditioning charge that carries no shrink, the three elevation-in charges, the receipt issuance fee, the February grade discount, the three accruals and the three settlements; the two storage requests; the grain contract GC-121773 and the two grain ledger rows. Rows excluded from money tests by their own flags: every charge on SI-661204, SI-661810 and SI-661874 carries paid_flag true and a matching settlement row, so only the January drying charge, the February grade discount and the 19 February to 20 March accrual stand unpaid on SI-661930 — that is what makes the wide charge holdback, not an author's assertion. The grain ledger row of 6 February is excluded from the intake readings by its disposition (contract_application, not storage) and the harvest row is excluded from the three-month applied window by its date.

Problem-tree card. Root storage_ext_loadout_release. Three prerequisite problems, exactly as drawn: storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release, storage_ext_conditioning_shrink and storage_ext_drying_pass. Shape: a fan from the root to the pledge and the shrink, with the drying hanging below the shrink.
  Edge A, storage_ext_loadout_release <- storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release. kind value_input; gate the compute binding free_bushels; form state; sentence, verbatim from the load-out rule: 'The bushels an order releases are fixed only once the bushels standing free on the agreement, the bushels on hand that are not pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt, reach the programme's load-out minimum.' Four-point test: the connective is 'only once'; the waiting side is a record-visible quantity (bushels on hand less bushels pledged, against the programme's minimum) and names no action, performer or tool; no tool name, policy id or code token appears; the strength is exactly the edge's, a hard 'only once' scoped to that minimum. Exactly one write of this difficulty raises the free bushels: the pledge release is the only policy that rewrites what the agreement carries as pledged, while the shrink write only lowers the bushels on hand and the load-out write is the thing being gated. Derivation: the sentence says the release waits on free bushels reaching the minimum; the records show 56652.00 on hand and 54000.00 pledged, so 2652.00 free against a 5000-bushel minimum; the pledge policy's own rule says the revised pledge is what a member who wants grain out from under an outstanding receipt has worked out before they sign, so that write is the one action that lifts the free bushels. Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.storage_agreements.<agreement>.reserved_bushels = 54000.00 against bushels backed out of the account at 56652.00.
  Edge B, storage_ext_loadout_release <- storage_ext_conditioning_shrink. kind value_input; gate the compute binding on_hand; form state; sentence: 'The bushels an order releases are fixed only after the storage account carries a shrink line raised no earlier than the most recent conditioning charge standing on it.' Four-point test: connective 'only after' and 'no earlier than'; the waiting side is a record-visible state (the dates of the newest shrink line and the newest conditioning charge); no action, performer, tool, id or code token; the strength is exact. Exactly one write brings it about: only the shrink policy puts a shrink line on the account. Unresolved at frozen_time: the newest conditioning charge is initial_state.storage_charges.<january pass>.charge_date = 2026-01-14 while the newest shrink line is initial_state.storage_charges.<harvest shrink>.charge_date = 2025-10-21.
  Edge C, storage_ext_conditioning_shrink <- storage_ext_drying_pass. kind value_input; gate the compute binding shrink_points; form state; sentence, verbatim from the shrink rule: 'The bushels taken off for shrink are fixed only after the storage account carries a conditioning charge raised on the day the bushels are taken off, since the shrink follows the pass that caused it.' Four-point test: connective 'only after'; the waiting side is a record-visible state (a conditioning charge whose charge date is the day of the shrink line); no tool, id or code token; exact strength. Exactly one write brings it about: only the drying policy raises a conditioning charge. Unresolved at frozen_time: the newest conditioning charge on the account is dated 2026-01-14, not 2026-04-09, so no charge stands for the pass being run today.
  Topological order: storage_ext_drying_pass, storage_ext_conditioning_shrink, storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release, storage_ext_loadout_release. Order uniqueness: the pledge branch and the drying-shrink branch are parallel and may be run either way round. They commute, and this was run both ways: the pledge computation reads only the storage requests, the pledged figure, the recheck requests, the unpaid accrual money, the deposit count, the receipt-issuance count and the grain position, none of which any drying or shrink write touches; the drying and shrink computations read the conditioning, deposit, shrink and load-out rows and the scale ticket, none of which the pledge write touches, since that write only rewrites reserved_bushels and warehouse_receipt_number on the agreement. Both orders leave 4173.66, 1019.74, 28000.00 and 24000.00 and the same terminal rows. Deletion sensitivity, actually run: skipping the pledge write leaves pledged at 54000.00, free bushels at 1632.26 and nothing left after the 1500, 400 and 800 holdbacks, so the released bushels fall to 0.00 instead of 24000.00; skipping the shrink write leaves on hand at 56652.00, free at 28652.00 and releasable at 25952.00, and the released bushels at 25000.00 instead of 24000.00; skipping the drying write leaves the shrink's points at 1.5 instead of 3.0, the bushels it is taken on at 52400.00 instead of 56652.00 and the shrink itself at 565.92 instead of 1019.74; the bushels finally released move with it, to 25000.00 when the gold shrink row is replayed unchanged (uncovered points fall to nothing, the conditioning reserve with them, and releasable rises to 25732.26) and to 26000.00 when the shrink is recomputed on the world the skip leaves (on hand 56086.08, free 28086.08, releasable 26186.08). Customer's own writes: two of the four problems are the member's, the pledge release and the load-out release, both owner=user, unlocked by the desk and run by him.

Factor card — storage_ext_drying_pass (6 factors, handling-time world = the opening world).
  pass_start_moisture_basis (method, cross-difficulty grain): a conditioning charge already stands on the account (the 14 January pass, moisture_out_pct 15.5), so the pass starts from 15.5 rather than from the 22.4 the scale read in on ticket T-3078801. Baseline is the scale reading, which gives 23372.50.
  run_down_target (parameter): the programme guarantees the grade written on the receipt and one receipt issuance stands on the account, so the grain is run down to 14.5 less the 0.5 receipt margin, 14.0. Baseline is the programme's 14.5 target, which gives 2782.44.
  dryer_bushels_basis (method): a conditioning charge stands on the account and no bushels have left store, so the pass is charged on the 52400.00 bushels that charge was raised on. Baseline is the most recent load into store, 14800.00, which gives 1178.82.
  intake_condition_rate_step (parameter, multi-source over two readings of the scale ticket, cross-difficulty grain): the scale read the corn in at 22.4 percent, above the 20 percent wet-intake mark, and weighed it at 52.4 pounds, below the 54.0 light-test weight, so the deep-dry step of 0.008 is added. Baseline is no step, which gives 3607.74.
  bin_rewarm_rate_step (parameter): 170 days in store from 2025-10-21 is past the 90-day rewarming count and no aeration cycle stands on the account, so the rewarming step of 0.006 is added. Baseline is no step, which gives 3749.22.
  committed_grain_allowance (parameter, multi-source over two record sets, the grain ledger's application rows and the grain contract header, cross-difficulty grain): 11200.00 bushels were applied to the member's marketing contracts on 6 February, inside three months and above the ten thousand mark, and contract GC-121773 stands active on yellow corn with 12000 open bushels, so the full 10 percent allowance comes off. Baseline is no allowance, which gives 4637.40.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 5261.40, against gold 4173.66.
Factor card — storage_ext_conditioning_shrink (6 factors, handling-time world = the opening world plus the drying write).
  shrink_bushels_basis (method): two conditioning charges carry points no shrink line covers, so the shrink is taken on the 56652.00 bushels standing in store. Baseline is the most recent charge's bushels, 52400.00, giving 943.20.
  shrink_points_basis (method): the conditioning charges show 8.4 points against 5.4 carried by the shrink lines, a difference of 3.0, more than the 1.5 the most recent charge shows, so the shrink is taken on 3.0 points. Baseline is the most recent charge's 1.5 points, giving 611.84.
  handling_shrink_percentage (parameter): three conditioning charges stand inside twelve months, so the programme's 0.50 percent carries the 0.10 re-handling step. Baseline is 0.50, giving 878.11.
  cleaning_shrink_step (parameter, cross-difficulty grain): the ticket shows 2.1 percent foreign material, above the 1.5 cleaning threshold, and the corn was taken in at 22.4 against a 14.5 target, so the 0.08 cleaning step is added. Baseline is no step, giving 906.43.
  damage_shrink_step (parameter, cross-difficulty grain): the ticket shows 3.4 percent damage, above the 3.0 threshold, while the grade of record is us_no_2 and not below it, so the second tier holds by its 'or' limb and the light step of 0.04 is added. Baseline is no step, giving 963.08.
  shrink_points_cap (parameter): 3.0 points stand above the 2.5 deep-shrink count and more than one charge is uncovered, so the points are capped at 2.5. Baseline is the points uncapped, giving 1223.68.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 393.00, against gold 1019.74.
Factor card — storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release (6 factors, handling-time world = the opening world plus the drying and shrink writes).
  redemption_margin_kept (parameter, multi-source over two record sets, the pledged figure and the recheck request): the receipt covers 54000.00, above the 25000 large-receipt count, and a quality recheck stands on the agreement, so the wide margin of 1250 is kept. Baseline is no margin, giving 26700.00.
  grade_of_record_margin (parameter): the grade of record is us_no_2 and not below US No. 2, so the first tier fails, but the grade discount of 24 February stands inside twelve months, so the second tier holds - the grade standing at US No. 2 or above with a grade discount raised inside twelve months - and the light grade margin of 300 is kept. Baseline is no grade margin, giving 27700.00.
  marketing_commitment_holdback (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty grain): 12000 bushels stand open on the active corn contract, short of the fifteen thousand of the top tier, and 11200.00 were applied in the last three months, so the second tier holds and 800.00 stays pledged. Baseline is nothing held, giving 27200.00.
  charge_lien_holdback (parameter): an accrual stands unpaid on the account, but this programme does settle storage out of grain proceeds, so the elevator has a settlement to draw the money from and the first tier fails; the second, which is the tier for an accrual standing unpaid where the elevator does have a settlement to draw on, holds and the light lien holdback of 800 stays pledged. Baseline is nothing held, giving 27200.00.
  commingled_lot_margin (parameter): the programme commingles with the house bin and the corn came in on three scale tickets, so the wide commingled margin of 780 is kept. Baseline is no margin, giving 27200.00.
  round_lot_convention (method): one receipt has been issued in the last twelve months, so the 27930.00 worked out is carried up to the next whole hundred, 28000.00. Baseline is the figure as worked out, 27930.00.
  Bindings belonging to no factor: the bushels the largest signed load-out request standing received names, 30000, and the reduction itself, 54000.00 less that, 24000.00 — the standard method the computation document states.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 24000.00, against gold 28000.00 — the receipt reduced by the bushels the member signed for and no margin kept, which is a reduction the elevator really performs rather than a write that changes nothing.
Factor card — storage_ext_loadout_release (6 factors, handling-time world = the opening world plus all three prerequisite writes).
  free_bushels_basis (method): the agreement carries 28000.00 pledged, so the free bushels are 55632.26 on hand less that, 27632.26. Baseline is the bushels on hand, giving 28000.00.
  unpaid_charge_holdback (parameter, multi-source): conditioning charges (3537.00 from January and 4173.66 raised today) and the accrual (129.31) both stand unpaid, so the wide holdback of 1500 stays in store. Baseline is nothing held, giving 26000.00.
  grade_guarantee_holdback (parameter, multi-source over two record sets, the grade-discount rows and the pledged figure): a grade discount was raised on 24 February, inside twelve months, and the agreement carries 28000.00 pledged under receipt WR-004182, which already keeps a margin standing for the same grade, so the second tier holds and the light grade holdback of 400 stays rather than the wide 900. Baseline is nothing held, giving 25000.00.
  conditioning_reserve_held (parameter, multi-source): the conditioning charges show 8.4 points against the 7.9 the shrink lines carry, so 0.5 points stand uncovered, and 28000.00 still stands pledged, so the wide conditioning reserve of 800 stays in store against the water yet to come off. Baseline is nothing held, giving 25000.00.
  facility_out_ceiling (parameter): the corn is held at Kellerton Rail Terminal and no load-out has been worked in the last thirty days, so the rail ceiling of 28000 applies. Baseline is the country ceiling of 12000, giving 12000.00.
  whole_load_rounding (method): the grain is at a rail terminal and the 24932.26 that may be released stands above ten truck lots, so it is carried down to a whole multiple of the 1000-bushel truck lot, 24000.00. Baseline is the figure as worked out, 24932.26.
  Bindings belonging to no factor: the order itself, which is for the 30000 bushels the signed load-out request standing received names — the figure base's own authorization gate guarantees exists.
  Whole-baseline fall-back: 12000.00, against gold 24000.00 — an order of 30000 bushels worked down to the country ceiling, which is a release the elevator really makes.
  Near-misses planted across the task: the grain ledger row of 6 February is a delivery applied to a marketing contract and not a load into store, so a reader who takes the latest ticket for the intake reading gets 14.2 percent moisture, 56.1 pounds and 0.9 percent foreign material and loses the deep-dry step, the cleaning step and the damage step; the 14 January conditioning charge carries no ticket number, tempting a reader to attach it to the harvest ticket and charge the pass on 24000.00; the paid charges on SI-661204, SI-661810 and SI-661874 tempt a reader into a wider unpaid balance than the three rows on SI-661930; and the header bushels_in_store of 57300.00 is a deliberately stale cache, the two shrink lines never having been rolled into it, against the 55632.26 the ledger backs out at the load-out's handling time. No rule reads that header, and the rules say so in terms.

Seed card. The customer row carries the two credentials the identity check uses. The agreement row fixes the programme (Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage: daily rate 0.00185, period 30 days, minimum 25.00, drying 0.045 a point a bushel to a 14.5 target with a 0.50 percent handling shrink and a 20.00 pass minimum, load-out minimum 5000 with two business days of notice, receipts allowed with insurance required, receipt grade guarantee, commingling allowed, settles from grain proceeds, patronage eligible), the 54000.00 pledge and receipt WR-004182 that edge A turns on, the grade of record the damage step reads, the storage start date the rewarming step counts from, and the stale header cache. The three deposits are what the on-hand figure, the deposit count and the intake tickets rest on; drop the third and the commingled margin falls to its light tier. The harvest drying pass and its shrink line are what make the points arithmetic real (8.4 against 5.4) and what the re-handling step counts; the January conditioning charge is the row that makes edge B false at the opening and the row the drying pass starts its moisture from. The three elevation-in charges and the receipt issuance fee are paid history, and the issuance fee is what puts the pledge on the next whole hundred rather than the next whole thousand. The grade discount of 24 February is the evidence of the grade holdback. The three accruals are the billing history; the unpaid one is what the lien holdback and half the charge holdback rest on. The three settlements show which invoices are clear. The signed load-out request is the base eligibility of the root problem and the figure the order names; the completed quality recheck is the second limb of the redemption margin. The grain contract and the two ledger rows carry every cross-difficulty reading. Automatic-clause check: the escalation point is 270 days and the corn has stood 170; max_storage_days is 730; the current billing period (21 March onward) has not closed, so no accrual is owed at frozen_time and task 0's accrual policy is not lit here; the account is inside its grace on the March invoice; nothing lights an obligation this task set cannot carry.

Persona design. Marlin Ellsworth speaks in short pieces, gives the surface goal (the order released today for the thirty thousand he signed for last Friday), the object (the corn at Kellerton), the timing (today, trucks Monday) and the authorisation boundary (the desk may read and work out; anything of his to sign, he signs, and he says so in his own words). He volunteers no figure and cannot produce one. Identity comes out only when asked, one thing at a time. His one natural reaction to a short release is to ask once what is keeping the rest back and then accept it; he never proposes a number or a method. Nothing in his script names the receipt, the pledge, the conditioning charge, the shrink or any notion of a first step; the two writes he performs he performs only after the desk explains and hands them over, and his arc ends exactly where the evaluation ends.

Reachability, turn by turn. Name and farm, then the membership number (action 0 locates on both), then the cell number and the last four (action 1 clears identity at K=2). The agreement read (action 2) gives the programme, the pledge, the receipt number, the agreement number, the grade and the facility; the storage account read (action 3) gives the conditioning and shrink rows with their points and moisture readings, the unpaid rows and their invoice, the grade discount and the load-out history; the requests read (action 4) gives the signed order and the recheck; the grain contract and ledger reads (actions 5 and 6) give the open bushels, the applied bushels and the three intake readings. Then the four writes in topological order, each through its unlock. Everything is synchronous under one frozen_time: the dryer pass is booked as a charge on the spot, the shrink is an account adjustment, the pledge is rewritten on the spot and the release is recorded on the spot; nothing waits on hauling, clearing, review or a future date, and the trucks on Monday are outside the task and outside gold.

Verification. Handling-time recomputation was run with the gate's own evaluator (build_env / eval_compute from skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py), replaying the real tools between problems. Output: drying 4173.66 (start_moisture 15.5, target 14.0, points 1.5, dryer_bushels 52400.0, deep_dry_step 0.008, rewarm_step 0.006, pass_rate 0.059, gross 4637.40, allowance_rate 10.0, allowance 463.74); shrink 1019.74 (standing 56652.0, unshrunk charges 2, drying points 8.4 against shrink points 5.4, shrink_points 3.0, handling 0.60 plus cleaning 0.08 plus damage 0.04 = 0.72, capped points 2.5); pledge 28000.00 (release basis 24000.0, redemption margin 1250, grade margin 300, commitment 800.0, lien 800, commingled 780, raw 27930.0, rounded to the next hundred); load-out 24000.00 (on hand 55632.26, pledged 28000.0, free 27632.26, holdbacks 1500, 400 and 800, releasable 24932.26, order 30000.0, ceiling 28000, carried down to whole truck lots). Per-factor baselines and whole baselines are as recorded in the factor cards and in computations[].factor_sensitivity; each differs from its gold.

Two-way equivalence. Forward: every world-reading or choosing binding of all four policies quotes its rule sentence in compute_basis — the ledger sums quote the backing-out sentences, each ladder binding quotes the sentence stating its tiers, the rate and percentage compositions quote the stacking sentences, and the final expressions quote the result sentences. Reverse sweep, drying rule: 'rounded to the nearest cent' -> RND on gross_charge and result; 'where what is left after any allowance falls under the programme's pass minimum' -> MX against P('drying_minimum_charge_usd') after the allowance; 'carried to one decimal place' -> RND(...,1) inside points_removed; 'a pass that would take out fewer than the programme's minimum points is billed at the minimum points' -> MX against P('drying_minimum_points'); 'carried to five decimal places' -> RND(...,5) on pass_rate; 'days in store are counted in whole calendar days from the storage start date' -> DAYS(F('storage_start_date'), NOW). Shrink rule: 'divided by one hundred and rounded to two decimal places' -> the result expression; 'carried to three decimal places' -> RND(...,3) on total_rate_pct; the cap sentence -> MN on capped_points. Pledge rule: 'taken to no less than nothing' -> MX(...,0) on raw_pledge; 'the rounding up is done once, on the total' -> the single rounded_pledge binding; 'never less than nothing' -> MX on the commitment holdback. Load-out rule: 'the smallest of' -> the nested MN; 'the ceiling is applied to what is left after them' -> the order of releasable and capped; 'the carrying down is done once, at the end' -> the single rounded_release binding; 'rounded to two decimal places' -> RND on result. No load-bearing sentence of any of the four rules is unclaimed, and no filter in any compute is missing from its prose.

Draft recomputation from the visible context alone, with the extended yaml, compute, expected and gold masked. From the published prose and the records: the member wants thirty thousand bushels out; the account shows 57300.00 taken in less 648.00 of shrink, so 56652.00 on hand, against 54000.00 pledged under WR-004182, leaving 2652.00 free against a 5000 minimum, so the order cannot be worked until the receipt is reduced (on those opening records the rule would release nothing at all, the holdbacks standing above the 2652.00 free); the account also shows a conditioning charge of 14 January with points no shrink line covers, so the on-hand figure is not yet right and a shrink line must be taken; and the shrink follows a pass charged the same day, so today's pass must be booked first. Working the published ladders against the records gives 4173.66 for the pass, 1019.74 for the shrink, 28000.00 for the revised pledge and 24000.00 for the bushels released, which is what gold carries. No second reading is available: each ladder selects exactly one tier on these records, the two dates and the request figure are fixed by the rows, and the carrying down is stated to happen once at the end.

Gates run after this task was written: check_extended --task 1, check_task_tools --task 1, replay_tasks --task 1, check_solvability --task 1, check_compute --task 1, check_grounding --task 1, check_cache_diff --task 1 and check_cross_fire --task 1, then the full difficulty-wide suite; outputs recorded in the session log. check_traceability is deferred until the knowledge base is rendered.

REVISION 2 - answering the round-1 policy-task audit (audits/policy_task/grain_storage_desk/1.md and _difficulty.md).

F2 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED, storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release's baseline). Symptom: the declared whole baseline was 54000.00, the figure already standing in reserved_bushels, so the computation document's own answer was a write that changes nothing; baseline.rule stated no default for the bushels released or for any margin, so a reader of it reached no number; and baseline.params named loadout_minimum_bushels and receipt_cancellation_fee_usd, neither of which the policy's compute contains. Root cause: the reduction itself had been made a factor (receipt_release_basis) whose fall-through was "the pledge stands as it is", which is a refusal rather than a method, and the baseline paragraph inherited that emptiness. Change: the reduction is now a plain binding and the standard method - "The pledge is reduced by the bushels the largest signed load-out request standing received on the agreement names" - which the baseline paragraph states outright together with the sum and the rounding; baseline.params is [] because that method uses no programme parameter; and the sixth factor is now grade_of_record_margin, a margin kept where the grade of record has slipped below US No. 2 or a grade discount stands on the account inside twelve months, which this world takes on its second tier. user_scenario:
You are Marlin Ellsworth, sixty-three, a corn and cattle man who farms the ridge north of Kellerton with his son and has hauled to Prairie Ridge since the old board days. You are on the phone from the pickup, engine idling, and you talk in short pieces with long pauses; you are not impatient, but you say a thing once and then wait for the other person to catch up. You call the elevator "the terminal".

The reason for the call is that you want your corn home. You signed the load-out slip at the scale house last Friday for thirty thousand bushels off the agreement at Kellerton, and you say near the start that you would like the order released today so the trucks can start Monday. The corn is for your own bunks and you are not selling it to anybody, so there is nothing to price and nothing to figure out about where it goes. You are content for the desk to look at whatever records it needs and to work out the numbers, and you say so; but anything that is yours to sign, you sign. You put it as: you do not want anybody at the terminal moving your own paper for you, so if there is something on the member portal that needs your hand on it, hand it over and you will do it while you are sitting here.

You do not know what is going to come back out of that bin and you say so if you are asked: the last statement you looked at was in February, you have not added up what has been done to the corn since, and the terminal's own books will know better than you do. You do not argue with figures. If the desk tells you that fewer bushels are coming out than the thirty thousand you asked for, you take it in, ask once what is keeping the rest of it back, listen to the answer, and say that is all right, send what you can. You never suggest a number of your own and you never tell the desk how any of it ought to be worked out.

You give nothing about yourself until you are asked. Asked who is calling, you give your name and say you farm as Ellsworth Ridge Farms; asked for the membership number you read it off the slip in the console, M-22736. If the desk wants something further to be sure of you, you give the cell number the terminal has, 5150223390, and if it wants a second thing, the last four of the tax number, 2263. Asked when you joined you say 2014-06-11, and asked for the email you say marlin@ellsworthridgefarms.com. Asked which agreement you mean, you say the corn at Kellerton from last fall, and that it is the only grain you have in store. Asked whether the corn is going anywhere other than home, you say no, it is going in your own bins. Asked anything about grades, moisture readings or what has been charged to the account, you say you could not tell them that from the pickup and the desk will have to read it off its own records.

When the desk puts something on the portal in front of you to sign, you do not argue about it: you say go ahead and put it in front of you, and when it is handed over you run it exactly as the desk states it and read back what comes up on the screen. When the desk hands you the release itself, you run that too, for the bushels the desk gives you, and you tell it what came back. Once you hear that the bushels are released and out of store, you are satisfied: you say you will send the first trucks Monday morning, thank the desk for staying on the phone with you, and let them go. You do not raise a second piece of business and you do not ask for anything to be sent to you.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the membership profile from the number the caller reads off his slip and the name he farms under, so the rest of the call works on one member record.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing on the account can be read without the member's internal reference, and identity cannot be checked against a profile that has not been found.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Establish that the caller is the member whose stored grain is about to be conditioned, re-pledged and released, by checking the cell number and the last four of the tax number against the profile.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must clear before any account business is transacted, and all four writes of this call move grain or money on the member's account.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's storage agreement: the programme, the facility, the agreement number, the bushels the header claims, the bushels pledged, the receipt standing against them, the grade of record, the storage start date and the standing of the agreement.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The programme fixes every rate, target, minimum, ceiling and guarantee used by all four computations; the pledged figure and the receipt number are what the free bushels and the pledge release turn on; the storage start date is the rewarming clock and the facility decides the out-load ceiling and the rounding.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole storage account: the three deposits, the harvest drying pass and its shrink line, the January conditioning charge that carries no shrink, the elevation-in charges, the receipt issuance fee, the February grade discount, the three accruals and the settlements that cleared them.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The bushels on hand are backed out of these rows, the points on both sides decide the shrink, the January charge's moisture reading is where today's pass starts, the unpaid rows decide the charge holdback and the lien holdback, the grade discount decides the grade holdback, the receipt issuance decides the round-lot convention, and the absence of any load-out row decides both the dryer bushels and the facility ceiling.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the service requests lodged against the agreement: the signed load-out request with the bushels it names and the date the elevator registered it, and the completed quality recheck.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The signed request is the base authorisation for releasing grain and the figure the order names; the recheck is the second condition of the redemption margin kept on the receipt.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's grain marketing contracts to see whether an active contract for the same commodity still carries open bushels.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The open bushels are one condition of the drying allowance and the quantity the marketing commitment holdback is worked from.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's grain ledger: the scale ticket the corn went into store on, with its moisture, test weight, foreign material and damage readings, and the load applied to a marketing contract in February.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The intake readings decide the deep-dry step, the cleaning step and the damage step, and the bushels applied in the last three months decide both the drying allowance and the marketing commitment holdback.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's own tool for raising a conditioning charge so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Raise the conditioning charge for the pass that runs the corn down to the moisture the receipt grade calls for, so the storage account carries a charge for the pass on the day it was run.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: storage_ext_drying_pass is the only policy that computes what a pass costs, and until its charge stands on the account the shrink that follows the pass cannot be worked out.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.agreement_id: The internal reference of storage agreement SA-219456, read from the return of the agreement lookup at action 2; it is the member's only storage agreement and the only grain he has in store, so there is one candidate.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.moisture_in_pct: 15.5, computed by policy. The rule states that where a conditioning charge already stands on the storage account showing the moisture the grain was left at, the pass starts from that moisture; the account read at action 3 shows the 14 January conditioning charge leaving the corn at 15.5 percent, so the pass begins there and not at the 22.4 percent the scale read in.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.moisture_out_pct: 14.0, computed by policy: the programme guarantees the grade written on the receipt and one receipt issuance stands on the account, so the grain is run down to the programme's 14.5 target less the 0.5 receipt margin.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.points_removed: 1.5, computed by policy as the moisture the pass started at less the moisture it is run down to, 15.5 less 14.0, carried to one decimal place and above the programme's 0.5 minimum points.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.bushels: 52400.00, computed by policy: a conditioning charge already stands on the account and no bushels have left store since the grain went in, so the pass is charged on the bushels that charge was raised on, which the account read at action 3 shows as 52400.00. The header figure of 57300.00 and the latest load of 14800.00 are not what the rule reads.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 4173.66, the result of storage_ext_drying_pass on the opening world. The rate starts at the programme's 0.045 a point a bushel; the scale read the corn in at 22.4 percent, above the 20 percent wet-intake mark, and weighed it at 52.4 pounds, below the 54.0 light-test weight, so the deep-dry step of 0.008 is added; 170 days in store from 2025-10-21 is past the 90-day rewarming count and no aeration cycle stands on the account, so the rewarming step of 0.006 is added; added on the same posted rate and carried to five decimal places that is 0.059. 52400.00 bushels at 1.5 points and 0.059 is 4637.40. 11200.00 bushels were applied to the member's marketing contracts on 6 February, inside three months and above ten thousand, and contract GC-121773 stands active on yellow corn with 12000 open bushels, so the full 10 percent allowance of 463.74 comes off, leaving 4173.66, which is above the programme's 20.00 pass minimum.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk's own tool for taking conditioning shrink off the bushels in store so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Take the conditioning shrink owed on the account off the bushels in store, so the account carries a shrink line no earlier than the most recent conditioning charge and the bushels backed out of it are the bushels really there.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: storage_ext_conditioning_shrink is the only policy that computes the bushels a shrink line takes off, and it is evaluated on the world the conditioning charge of action 8 leaves; until it lands, the bushels on hand the release is worked against are overstated.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.agreement_id: The same storage agreement reference read at action 2 and already used at action 8; the shrink is owed on that agreement and on no other.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.bushels: 56652.00, computed by policy: two conditioning charges on the account carry points no shrink line covers, so the shrink is taken on the bushels standing in store, backed out of the account as 57300.00 taken in less 648.00 already taken off for shrink and nothing loaded out. The agreement header's 57300.00 is not what the rule reads.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.points_removed: 2.5, computed by policy. The conditioning charges show 5.4 plus 1.5 plus the 1.5 raised at action 8, that is 8.4 points, while the shrink lines carry 5.4, a difference of 3.0, which is more than the 1.5 the most recent charge shows, so the shrink is taken on 3.0 points; and because 3.0 stands above the 2.5 deep-shrink count while more than one charge is uncovered, the points are capped at 2.5.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.shrink_bushels: 1019.74, the result of storage_ext_conditioning_shrink on the world as it stands after action 8. The percentage begins at the programme's 0.50 for each point and carries the 0.10 re-handling step because three conditioning charges stand inside twelve months; the ticket's 2.1 percent foreign material is above the 1.5 cleaning threshold and the corn was taken in at 22.4 against a 14.5 target, so the 0.08 cleaning step is added; the ticket's 3.4 percent damage is above the 3.0 threshold while the grade of record is us_no_2 and not below it, so the light damage step of 0.04 is added; added on the same percentage and carried to three decimal places that is 0.72. 56652.00 bushels at 2.5 points and 0.72 percent is 1019.74.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own action for reducing what stands pledged under his warehouse receipt so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The member reduces his own warehouse receipt so that the pledge stands at the revised figure and the bushels released from it are free to move.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release is the only policy that computes what stands pledged after a receipt is reduced; the member performs it himself because the receipt is his own paper, and until it lands the bushels standing free are below the programme's load-out minimum.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.agreement_number: SA-219456, copied character for character from the agreement lookup return at action 2, which shows it as the agreement number printed on the member's storage statements; the base rule on receipts and pledges binds its evidence through that number, and the member holds only this one agreement.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.warehouse_receipt_number: WR-004182, copied character for character from the same return, which carries it as the receipt issued against the stored grain; base states that issuing a receipt pledges the bushels it names and that cancelling or reducing it releases them, and only one receipt stands on the agreement.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.reserved_bushels: 28000.00, the result of storage_ext_receipt_pledge_release on the world as it stands after actions 8 and 10. The pledge is reduced by the bushels the largest load-out request standing received and signed by the member names, 30000, so 24000.00 of the 54000.00 the receipt covers is left on it; the receipt covers more than the 25000 large-receipt count and a quality recheck stands on the agreement, so the wide redemption margin of 1250 is kept; the grade of record is us_no_2 and not below it, but a grade discount was raised on 24 February, inside twelve months, so the light grade margin of 300 is kept; 12000 bushels stand open on the active corn contract, short of fifteen thousand, while 11200.00 were applied in the last three months, so 800.00 stays pledged for the marketing commitment; an accrual stands unpaid but this programme does settle storage out of grain proceeds, so the wide lien holdback fails and the light one of 800 stays; the programme commingles with the house bin and the corn came in on three scale tickets, so the wide commingled margin of 780 is kept. That is 27930.00, and because one receipt has been issued in the last twelve months it is carried up to the next whole hundred, 28000.00.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the member's own action for taking the released grain out of store so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once for this tool.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The member releases the load-out himself against his signed request, and the bushels moving out come off what the storage account shows in store.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: storage_ext_loadout_release is the only policy that computes the bushels an order actually releases, and it is evaluated on the world the three prerequisite writes leave; the member performs it himself because moving his own grain is his act.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.agreement_id: The same storage agreement reference read at action 2; the signed request and the grain both stand on that agreement.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.request_id: The internal reference of the signed load-out request, read from the storage service request lookup at action 4. Base requires that a signed load-out request naming the bushels is registered before the order is released, and the lookup shows exactly one request of that kind, signed by the member, standing received for 30000 bushels; the completed quality recheck is not a load-out request, so no other candidate remains.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.bushels: 24000.00, the result of storage_ext_loadout_release on the world as it stands after actions 8, 10 and 12. Bushels on hand are 57300.00 taken in less 1667.74 taken off for shrink and nothing loaded out, that is 55632.26; the agreement carries 28000.00 pledged, so 27632.26 stand free; conditioning charges and the accrual both stand unpaid, so the wide charge holdback of 1500 stays in store; a grade discount was raised on 24 February, and because the agreement still carries bushels pledged under a receipt that already keeps a margin standing for grade, the light grade holdback of 400 stays rather than the wide one; and the conditioning charges still show 0.5 points no shrink line covers while bushels stand pledged, so the wide conditioning reserve of 800 stays too, leaving 24932.26 releasable. The order is for the 30000 bushels the signed request names, and the corn is at a rail terminal with no load-out worked in the last thirty days, so the ceiling is 28000; the smallest of those three is 24932.26, and because the grain is at a rail terminal and that stands above ten truck lots it is carried down to a whole multiple of the 1000-bushel truck lot, 24000.00.

edges.policy_source: The bushels an order releases are fixed only once the bushels standing free on the agreement, the bushels on hand that are not pledged against an outstanding warehouse receipt, reach the programme's load-out minimum.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The pledge branch and the drying-shrink branch hang off the root in parallel and may be run either way round; both orders were run and both leave 4173.66, 1019.74, 28000.00 and 24000.00 and the same terminal rows. They commute because they touch disjoint state: the pledge computation reads the storage requests, the pledged figure, the recheck count, the unpaid accrual money, the deposit count, the receipt-issuance count and the grain position, none of which a drying or shrink write alters, while the drying and shrink computations read the conditioning, deposit, shrink and load-out rows and the scale ticket, none of which the pledge write alters, since that write rewrites only reserved_bushels and warehouse_receipt_number on the agreement. Inside the drying-shrink branch the order is not free: the shrink rule's own sentence makes the shrink wait on a conditioning charge raised the same day.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the pledge write and replaying everything else leaves reserved_bushels at 54000.00, the free bushels at 1632.26 and nothing left after the 1500, 400 and 800 holdbacks, so the scored bushels released fall from 24000.00 to 0.00 and the terminal account carries no load-out row of any size.

Skipping the shrink write leaves the bushels on hand at 56652.00 instead of 55632.26, the free bushels at 28652.00 instead of 27632.26 and the releasable bushels at 25952.00 instead of 24932.26, so the scored bushels released rise from 24000.00 to 25000.00; the terminal account also lacks the shrink line itself.

Skipping the drying write and replaying the rest unchanged leaves the conditioning charges showing 6.9 points instead of 8.4, so the shrink's own scored parameter falls from 1019.74 to 565.92 on 1.5 points and 52400.00 bushels. The bushels finally released move too: with the gold shrink row replayed unchanged the conditioning charges no longer outrun it, uncovered_points falls from 0.5 to 0.0 and the conditioning reserve from 800 to nothing, so releasable rises from 24932.26 to 25732.26 and the release rises from 24000.00 to 25000.00; and if the shrink is itself recomputed on the world the skip leaves (565.92 on 1.5 points), bushels on hand stand at 56086.08, free at 28086.08, releasable at 26186.08 and the release at 26000.00. Either replay moves a scored value.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names none of the three prerequisite problems and nothing they resolve. Marlin never mentions the warehouse receipt, the pledged bushels, the conditioning charge of January, the shrink or any sense that something must be settled first; he says only that he signed for thirty thousand bushels and would like the order released, that he does not know what will come out of the bin, and that anything of his to sign he signs. Everything he contributes about a prerequisite is a passive response after the desk explains it: he runs what is handed to him and reads back what the screen says, and if fewer bushels come out than he asked for he asks once what is keeping the rest back and accepts the answer without offering a number or a method.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: No tool validates a prerequisite. release_loadout_bushels_2fb9cebd in task_tools.py reads the agreement only to copy the owning member onto the row and then calls ctx.create unconditionally: it does not compare the bushels against what is free, does not look at the pledge, the shrink lines or the request's notice period, raises no error and returns the same confirmation line whatever the state of the account. record_conditioning_shrink_cafcaf64 is equally unconditional and never checks whether a conditioning charge stands for the day. reduce_receipt_pledge_f1b6f4e9 looks up the agreement by its number only to find the row to update, and refuses nothing on policy grounds. An agent that skips a prerequisite gets a clean receipt and a different terminal hash, which is the only consequence.

dryer_bushels_basis (method): a conditioning charge stands on the account and no load-out row exists, so the pass is charged on the 52400.00 bushels that charge was raised on; the baseline is the most recent load into store, 14800.00, which would have given 1178.82.

intake_condition_rate_step (parameter, cross-difficulty grain): the scale ticket reads 22.4 percent moisture, above the 20 percent mark, and 52.4 pounds test weight, below the 54.0 light weight, so the deep-dry step of 0.008 is added; the baseline is no step, which would have given 3607.74.

bin_rewarm_rate_step (parameter): 170 days from the storage start date 2025-10-21 is past the 90-day rewarming count and no aeration charge stands on the account, so the rewarming step of 0.006 is added; the baseline is no step, which would have given 3749.22.

committed_grain_allowance (parameter, multi-source over two record sets, the grain ledger's application rows and the grain contract header, cross-difficulty grain): grain ledger row of 6 February applies 11200.00 bushels to a marketing contract inside three months, above ten thousand, and contract GC-121773 is active on yellow corn with 12000 open bushels, so the full 10 percent allowance applies; the baseline is no allowance, which would have given 4637.40.
